method: Sampled frames from the complete three-camera composite; numeric scoring and every-frame counts audited separately.
observations: Held tool follows the long seam and both transverse end-fold paths.
The first plain flap is released outward before the second is opened.
The second flap is pinched at its ordinary edge, without a handle.
Final item is on the green pad and the cutter rests on its orange pad.
repeat: All three unbox-plain-full-005 camera MP4s have identical hashes to full-004.
limits: Exact 1 mm sweep coverage and release distances are established from measured telemetry, not asserted from pixels.
